results.title: May
results.overview: May was filmed as a backdrop to part of a theatre performance D36-D37 under the E. F. Burian's lead inspired by the classic Czech poem of the same name by Karel Hynek Macha.

results.title: Pianke
results.overview: The story of a young German boy and his father who befriend a Jewish family during WWII.

results.title: Aimless Walk
results.overview: This first true Czech avant-garde film turns away from a purely celebratory approach to the city. The camera follows a detached protagonist on his wanderings, as his highly subjective journey becomes a fragmented visualization of urban landscapes.

results.title: Late Check-In
results.overview: He's alone, he is all tied up, and he doesn't know who did it to him.

results.title: There's a Tulip in Vilnius
results.overview: Inspired by a deceased, extravagant Vilnius fashion icon, Indrė sets out to follow in her footsteps, only to face resistance from those around her.

results.title: Lucky
results.overview: Tess is minutes into a blind date when the world suddenly falls apart. Should she accept Sebastian's offer to escape to his remote island? It would mean leaving behind everyone she loves for an uncertain future with a stranger. It might also be her only chance to survive. She's got six minutes to decide.

results.title: nothing.
results.overview: a moment passes. a memory remains. somewhere between time and memory, moments come and go.  a quiet journey along the Baltic Sea. nothing to explain. nothing to hold on to. just the passing of time.

results.title: A House in One Night
results.overview: It is said that Penrhos cottage was built in one night. According to Welsh folklore, if you could build a house overnight on common land, with smoke rising from the chimney by dawn, the place would be yours to keep. 200 years later in rural Pembrokeshire, the house stands still in time. Beneath its thatched roof lived Rachel and Maria, two sisters who spent their days crafting a life that defied societal rules written for women. Quietly radical, the pair were celebrated by the whole community. Tŷ Unnos is a fairytale documentary told through the eyes of the children who once visited. Recounting memories of Penrhos and the legacy of its last owners, the past flickers back to life.

results.title: Charles & Danny
results.overview: An ex high school basketball star learns to overcome personal struggles and pivots to a new chapter in his life by coaching a disabled teenager to play basketball.

results.title: Alone At Night
results.overview: An empathy-provoking journey through a seemingly safe city, told through the wary eyes of a young woman, Emma, who sees everything on her nighttime walk as heightened.

results.title: METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN
results.overview: This release is METALVERSE's first live video work, capturing their solo concert "METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN". Furthermore, it includes many songs that have not been released digitally, making it a special release that allows viewers to check out songs they haven't been able to see or hear before. This release captures the energetic performance of MIKO, SAKIA, and COCONA from METALVERSE, who "appeared" before a sold-out, packed audience. Also noteworthy are the incredible playing of HAL-CA (g/ASTERISM), Li-sa-X (g/KOIAI), Yunika Impact (b/Kakumei Meroik, KOIAI), and Fuwawa (dr/Kakumei Meroik), who participated as part of the girls' band project METALVERSE VΛND PROJECT (MVP).

results.title: Ouroboros
results.overview: A detective is appointed to a murder case, and must look within himself to uncover the truth behind who the killer really is.

results.title: BUDDY
results.overview: A heartfelt story about family, friendship, and the journey to truly connect.

results.title: Buddy
results.overview: The film centers on themes of family, forgiveness, and sacrifice. It explores the deep and heavily tested bonds of a family navigating profound heartbreak, unexpected challenges, and the long road toward healing. As past hurts resurface, the characters are forced to confront their mistakes, test their relationships, and find out what it truly means to sacrifice for the ones they love.

results.title: At Home
results.overview: Two young siblings are happily at play in their blanket fort, until an ominous shadow with a life of its own threatens their safe haven. As they hunt the shadow down through a dark deserted house, make belief melts into reality and the memory of that night bleeds across timelines.

results.title: Three Steps Forward
results.overview: A married couple's life is shattered by a premature loss. From that grief a conflict is born, and the two lovers no longer seem able to communicate. The loss hangs suspended between them: on one side, a woman who needs love to start living again; on the other, an astronaut frightened by the immensity of this pain, who sees the cosmos as a refuge.
